name: REA - Reverse Engineer Anything (morluto/rea)
description: Reverse engineer anything with autonomous agents, from application behavior, JS/Electron runtimes, and APKs down to native binaries with deterministic Evidence IDs.
author: Aetherion Platform Team (ref: morluto/rea)

provided_tools.name: rea_scope_gate
provided_tools.description: Confirm target authorization and initialize a deterministic REA case file before inspecting any binary or runtime target.

target_path.description: Path or URI of the binary, package, or runtime target.

authorization_note.description: Explicit ownership or written authorization confirmation.

provided_tools.name: rea_inspect_binary
provided_tools.description: Inspect native binaries (ELF/PE/Mach-O), Go binaries, WASM, .NET assemblies, or Android APKs for sections, symbols, strings, imports/exports, and bounded function dossiers.

provided_tools.name: rea_observe_js_runtime
provided_tools.description: Passive Inspector protocol observation (Runtime.enable, Debugger.enable) for Node.js and Electron targets without code injection or breakpoint mutation.

provided_tools.name: rea_reconstruct_feature
provided_tools.description: Synthesize a deterministic Finding Ledger with Evidence IDs and generate a clean-room implementation plan for a reverse-engineered feature.
